source.check: the five divisions and names read from the News-Letter's 'Down local elections' report (27 April 1933, p. 16), which states that there were no nominations for the other eleven divisions

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. S. J. Crail at the Lisburn Union offices on 26 April 1933. Five divisions were nominated; there were no nominations for the other eleven, whose sitting members were automatically returned. Polling in County Down took place on 25 May 1933. Filed on 1933-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
